adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is derived by filtering out emails that are already in `booking.attendees` and any in `BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS` (the filter at ~74-78). If at least one email remains, the mutation proceeds and returns only `{ message: "Guests added" }`, and the UI shows a generic success toast (`showToast(t("guests_added"), "success")`). There is no indication in either the API response or UI which submitted emails were skipped, so a user could reasonably believe all entered emails were added. This is grounded in the diff, but it’s more of a UX/contract completeness issue than a clear correctness defect.
